titulo: Your channel, in the right order
hero_alt: A tidy desk with an open planning notebook, a calendar and a vertical phone propped up.
lead: You've seen the whole pipeline. Now put the pieces together in the order they depend on each other: the reel on paper, the rules, the base, the checked script, the schedule and the week with the gate. Generate your plan with dates and go back to the course overview to see how this step rests on the other three.
objetivo: leave with a dated plan for the 7 exercises of step 4 and be able to say, for each stage, what proves it is done.

secoes.titulo: The pieces, in order of dependency
secoes.sub: Click each step. Each one uses what came before.

nos.detalhe: The reel in 7 steps, built from a plan scored 7 or higher. Proof: you read it in under 45 s and the first sentence hooks.
canais.md and regras.md. Proof: 5 references with a one-line criterion and the mandatory notice written out.
base.md from a transcribed video. Proof: confere.py prints only OK.
The 60 s script you asked the agent for. Proof: every number is in the base and the gate checklist is checked off.
The timer or cron written out. Proof: the next run shows up and you know what happens on a day with no topic.
A week of approving every video, with each rejection turning into a rule. Proof: 3 days in a row with no rejections.

secoes.legenda: The extra challenge (3 videos for the same audience, lesson 6) comes in once E4 is ready. It doesn't depend on the schedule.

secoes.sub: Pick a start date and how much time you have per week. The plan respects the exercises that need days of real use.

txt.travou: ## What I rejected and the rule I created

itens.texto: Every number on screen has who said it, the video, and the exact excerpt. If it doesn't, it doesn't go in.
Plan, text, and checking come before avatar and render. The gate sits where the spending starts.
The schedule runs on its own, but each rejection of yours becomes a line in regras.md. The gate only opens when the rejections stop.

secoes.sub: Where this step fits: terminal, assistant, queues, and social media.
One question per piece of the pipeline.

perguntas.p: Which of these orders respects the dependencies between the pieces?
opcoes: Week with a gate → regras → base.
Regras → base → checked script → schedule → week with a gate.
perguntas.explica: The base depends on the references and the rules; the script depends on the base; the schedule only makes sense with a checked script; the gate comes last, with the schedule running.

perguntas.p: What proves your sourced base is ready?
opcoes: The checker finds each excerpt in the transcript (OK only).
perguntas.explica: Done when is something you can verify: the script looks for each excerpt in the transcript. An opinion, yours or the agent's, is not proof.

perguntas.p: Where does the gate protect the most money and time?
opcoes: Before the avatar and the render, which cost money and can't be undone.
perguntas.explica: In promoavatar, the first gate protects the avatar spend and the second protects the render spend. The text is the cheap part to get wrong.
